tooltip.relicward.model_preview: Dormant guardian. Right-click in survival to challenge; court victories grant rewards.
tooltip.relicward.maul: 11 damage, 1.1 speed. Charge 0.9s, downswing 0.5s, impact, recover 0.5s. 14 damage, 5-block range, 5s fracture; 5s cooldown. Release before impact to cancel.
tooltip.relicward.pendant: Equip in a Curios necklace slot. Ready after 3s: reduce a hit of at least 6 damage by 30%, 25s cooldown. No offhand effect.
message.relicward.begin: The Bell Warden awakens. Jump over low waves and lure its charge into the pillars!
message.relicward.use_altar: Use the Court Bell at the arena entrance.
message.relicward.survival_required: Challenge in survival/adventure mode with peaceful difficulty disabled.
message.relicward.already_active: The trial is active. Enter the court to join.
message.relicward.obstructed: Arena obstructed at %s, %s, %s. Restore the floor or clear the marked block.
message.relicward.victory: The bell falls silent. Loot drops on the ground; your first trophy goes to your inventory.
message.relicward.inventory_full: Remaining rewards will be delivered when inventory space is available.
message.relicward.cooldown: The next trial will be ready in %s seconds (offer 5 Bronze Fragments to restart immediately).
message.relicward.need_fragments: Trial on cooldown: 5 Bronze Fragments required to restart immediately (%s/5).
message.relicward.fragment_restart: Bronze Resonance! Offered 5 Bronze Fragments; the court tolls and the trial restarts!
advancement.relicward.victory.desc: Complete the court trial and collect the spoils
message.relicward.auto_rewards: Trial rewards delivered to your inventory (%s items).
message.relicward.auto_full: Inventory full. Remaining rewards are saved and delivered automatically when space is available.
message.relicward.protected: The court protects this battlefield from destruction or construction.
tooltip.relicward.trophy: First-victory trophy. Place outside the protected court; light level 6, no combat stat bonuses.
message.relicward.bound: Bound: empty-hand use toggles follow/stay; repair paste restores health.
tooltip.relicward.binding_seal: Use on a wild puppet: consumes one to bind. Companion health 32; follows, defends and stays.
tooltip.relicward.repair_paste: Use on your puppet: restores 12 health; not consumed at full health.
tooltip.relicward.bell_shield: Immediate blocking. Block within the first 0.5s: no durability cost, cleanse Armor Fracture, repel nearby attacker and fracture armor for 4s. 4s cooldown.
tooltip.relicward.bell_anvil: Anchored anvil: repair, combine enchantments and rename. No falling or wear; vanilla XP costs.
tooltip.relicward.bell_armor: Bellforged armor: 5% knockback resistance per piece; repaired with Resonant Plates.
message.relicward.reinforcements: Resonant reinforcements: %s copper puppets join the battle!
message.relicward.super_gravity: Crushing resonance: movement -40%, gravity +60%, flight suppressed!
tooltip.relicward.resonant_bell: Use on ground: a 20-block ring deals 8 damage and 8s Armor Fracture. 8s cooldown; costs 2 durability.
message.relicward.perfect_block: Perfect resonance! Armor restored; attacker repelled.
